findings.message: `datetime.now()` returns a naive local datetime, but `expires_at` was previously compared against `datetime.now(UTC)` and so is timezone-aware. Comparing naive and aware datetimes raises `TypeError`, which breaks every reset-token check. Even with naive values, local time would shift expiry by the server's UTC offset.
This changes how token expiry is evaluated, but the pull request adds no test for the new behaviour.
